description: This Java source file defines the VehicleFragment class, which is an Android Fragment responsible for displaying a list of vehicle data in a RecyclerView. It loads vehicle information from internal storage, parses JSON data, and populates the UI with vehicle details.

classes.name: VehicleFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a list of vehicles by loading data from internal storage, parsing JSON, and populating a RecyclerView.

methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of VehicleFragment.
